title: Chocolate Chia Pudding
ingredients: 1 tbsp (approx. 5g) unsweetened cocoa powder or chocolate powder
1 tbsp (15 ml) maple syrup or honey
instructions: Whisk cocoa and oat milk: In a glass jar or small bowl, whisk the cocoa powder with a splash of oat milk until a smooth chocolate paste forms. Stir in the remaining oat milk, maple syrup or honey, vanilla extract, and salt. Mixing the cocoa into a paste first prevents clumps.
Add chia seeds and rest: Whisk in the chia seeds vigorously for 1 minute. Let sit for 5–10 minutes, then whisk again to break up any settled seeds and distribute them evenly.
Chill to set: Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, ideally overnight, until thickened and completely set.
notes: Estimated nutrition per serving using standard unsweetened cocoa powder, 2 tbsp chia seeds, unsweetened oat milk, and 1 tbsp pure maple syrup: 1.2g saturated fat, 12g added sugar, 22g net carbohydrates, calcium ~20% DV, and iron ~18% DV. Omitting the maple syrup reduces total carbohydrates to 20g, sugars to 1g, and calories to ~180 kcal. Honey or chocolate powder may change these estimates.
